title: Will USDA's South Dakota alfalfa hay price average exceed $150/ton in the October 2026 hay report?
resolutionCriteria: Resolves YES if the USDA Agricultural Marketing Service's South Dakota Hay Report (ams.usda.gov) shows a large square/round bale alfalfa (good/premium quality) average price above $150 per ton in any report published during October 2026; NO otherwise.
falsifier: Wrong if USDA AMS's own South Dakota Hay Report for October 2026 disagrees with the recorded probability's implied side.
